saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 26ης Δεκεμβρίου — «Άγιος Ευθύμιος ο Ομολογητής, επίσκοπος Σάρδεων»

attestations.note: The life page `/2795/` heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 26 Δεκεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder already keeps for the Romanian, and it is the same man, the confessor bishop of Sardis beaten to death for the icons. What the page prints for a life is one long quotation from S. Eustratiades's Hagiology, in Greek of the last century, and everything in the upgrade comes out of it. **The page's head and the passage it quotes do not agree about when he died.** The head gives «(; - 840)» and is the only year of death on the page; the narrative, however, ends with his recall by Michael the Stammerer, whose reign it dates 820 to 829, his anathema spoken to the emperor's face, his exile to Akritas and his death eight days after the beating. The `dates` drafted take the head's year with `basis` traditional, and the note records the reign the narrative ends in. Two other things to read as the page's and not as corrections: it calls the Leo of 813 to 820 «Λέοντος τοῦ Ἰσαύρου», which those years do not fit, and it has his first exile to the island of Παττάλαρα on a charge that he had tonsured a girl whom a senior official wanted to marry. The skull of the saint is at the church of his name at Keratsini of Piraeus, which is not drafted; Lykaonia, Alexandria, Sardis, Nicaea, Assos by Adramyttion and Akritas are named and no coordinate is proposed. No hymn is printed on the Greek page, and the folder's Romanian troparion is untouched. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs (28 September 2026).

hymns.text: Îndreptător credinţei şi chip blândeţelor, învăţător înfrânării te-a arătat pe tine, turmei tale, adevărul lucrurilor. Pentru aceasta ai dobândit cu smerenia cele înalte şi cu sărăcia cele bogate; Părinte Ierarhe Eftimie, roagă pe Hristos Dumnezeu să mântuiască sufletele noastre.

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfântului Ierarh Eftimie Mărturisitorul, Episcopul Sardei, glasul 4 (the common of a hierarch, printed with his name in it)

english.text: The truth of things has shown you to your flock a rule of faith, an image of gentleness and a teacher of continence. Therefore you have gained the heights by humility and riches by poverty. Father and hierarch Euthymius, pray to Christ God that our souls may be saved.

death.note: saint.gr's head for the page gives «Αγιος Ευθυμιος ο Ομολογητης, Επισκοπος Σαρδεων (; - 840)», and it is the only year of death the page carries. The Eustratiades passage the same page quotes ends his life under Michael the Stammerer, «(820 - 829 μ.Χ.)», who recalled him from exile and then exiled him to Akritas, where he died «ὀκτὼ ἡμέρας μετὰ τὴν ἄθλησιν»; that is recorded here and not reconciled with 840. No year of birth is given: the passage says only that he flourished under Constantine and Irene, «(780 - 797 μ.Χ.)», was born in Lykaonia and studied at Alexandria. The folder held no `dates` before this.
